purpose: Estimate whether recommendation exposure changes a shopping agent's resolved action without changing which candidates the agent is allowed to select.
claimBoundary: The study concerns model choices in a research storefront. It does not identify human preference change, production-retailer effects, trained-model deletion, or an actor-provenance effect.

sampling.frame: All 460 previously generated tasks, 115 per category, without opportunity or margin enrichment.
sampling.seedAssignment: sha256(category/taskId/modelFamily) modulo three; fixed before LLM calls
sampling.dependence: Inference resamples tasks, keeping the two recommender-family observations for a task together.

conditionMeaning.immediate-a: temporary task views are active in the platform ranking; replicate A
conditionMeaning.held-a: temporary task views are excluded from the platform ranking; replicate A
conditionMeaning.immediate-b: temporary task views are active in the platform ranking; replicate B
conditionMeaning.held-b: temporary task views are excluded from the platform ranking; replicate B

callOrder.method: four frozen Latin-square rotations selected by sha256(provider/category/taskId/modelFamily)

decisionInstrument.candidateUniverse: A symmetric union of immediate shelf, held shelf, task-local retrieval, and search, truncated by a pooled rank that uses both arms. The identical candidate IDs are sent in both arms.
decisionInstrument.inspection: The highest-ranked platform candidate is marked as inspected and remains selectable in the same decision call.
decisionInstrument.layoutReplicates: Replicates A and B use two frozen candidate orders; each order is shared by its matched immediate and held call.
decisionInstrument.privacy: Only pseudonymous candidate IDs and derived constraint, rank, utility, novelty, and inspection fields are sent.

stateContract.matchedStateCheck: After an abandoned task is resolved, both arms must hash to the same platform-input history before any next task is evaluated.
stateContract.behaviorBoundary: If actions differ, the downstream committed histories are different by definition and are not treated as failed deletion.

primaryEstimands.exposureManipulationRate: Fraction of task-model units for which any platform-rank field changes in the common candidate universe.
primaryEstimands.naturalOpportunityPrevalence: Fraction of task-model units for which the highest-ranked constraint-matching platform candidate in the common universe differs between immediate and held arms.
primaryEstimands.overallActionDistributionDistance: 2 times mean cross-arm disagreement minus immediate within-arm disagreement minus held within-arm disagreement, averaged over the natural task frame.
primaryEstimands.conditionalActionDistributionDistance: The same estimator among opportunity-positive task-model units.
primaryEstimands.sameLayoutDivergence: Mean of immediate-a versus held-a and immediate-b versus held-b action disagreement; descriptive only.
primaryEstimands.decisionQualityDifference: Held minus immediate difference in the frozen continuous decision-quality score; reported with a paired cluster-bootstrap interval.

decisionQuality.selectedCandidateScore: zero for constraint violations; otherwise 0.40 taskUtility + 0.25 reciprocal task-local rank + 0.20 reciprocal search rank + 0.15 novelty
decisionQuality.abandonScore: one only when no constraint-matching candidate exists in the common candidate universe; otherwise zero
decisionQuality.interpretation: A protocol-defined surrogate over offered candidates, not human utility.

uncertainty.providerPolicy: Estimate each provider separately; do not pool providers as independent observations.
uncertainty.multiplicity: DeepSeek is the primary provider for the action estimand. MiMo is a prespecified replication.

mechanismPolicy.dominance: The old dominance AUC is withdrawn. Any replacement separation analysis is exploratory and must be evaluated only within opportunity-positive units.
mechanismPolicy.actorProvenance: Not manipulated and therefore not a causal contribution of this study.

failureAccounting: inspected candidate absent from offered candidates
missingDataPolicy: A provider failure after frozen retries is recorded as the action category __PROTOCOL_FAILURE__ and remains in the action denominator. Decision quality uses complete units, with a worst-case guardrail sensitivity that assigns held failures zero and immediate failures one.
